sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-313.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 313 no longer exits. PD 313 was created by Ordinance No. 20333, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 14, 1989. Ordinance No. 20333 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 20333 was amended by Ordinance No. 23827, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 24, 1999. Subsequently, Ordinance Nos. 24136 and 24137, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 8, 1999, changed the zoning on the Property from PD 313 to PDs 561 and 562, respectively. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 20333; 23827; 24136; 24137; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-313.102. PROPERTY LOCATION.

PD 313 was established on property generally fronting on the north line of Keller Springs Road, east of the east line of Dallas Parkway. (Ord. Nos. 20333; 25850)
